title: The classification of some polynomial maps in dimension three
summary: In the paper, we classify all polynomial maps of the form $H=(u(x,y),\allowbreak v(x,y,z),h(x,y,z))$ in the case that $JH$ is nilpotent and $°_zv\geq 2°_zh$. Then we give the structure of $H=(u(x,y),v(x,y,z),h(x,y,z))$ if $JH$ is nilpotent and $°_zh\leq 3$.
